interpretation: Energy score was the strongest of the four tested scores, but the calibrated operating point still falsely rejected 51.13% of held-out PlantVillage in-domain images while detecting 94.96% of held-out external images. This is useful OOD discrimination evidence but not a deployment-ready threshold.
limitations: external calibration/evaluation splits are random within dataset
PlantDoc and Cassava are dataset/domain proxies, not farm/season/cultivar/device benchmarks
next_gate: explainability and shortcut analysis, with Grad-CAM/occlusion and background-versus-leaf controls
